top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Advance, Bond Yields in Focus: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures rose in early Asian trading, steadying sentiment at the start of a new quarter after late swings on Wall Street erased gains sparked by softer-than-expected inflation data.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Hedge funds hold a record share of the $30 trillion Treasury market. What could go wrong?
top_signals.summary: Hedge funds can boost Treasury market liquidity, but their growing role also risks creating financial instability.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
